examples.en: My younger sibling attends an art academy.
I'm learning to cook at an academy.

examples.ko: 그 영화는 아카데미 시상식에서 상을 받았어요.
examples.en: That film won an award at the Academy Awards.
A new academy opened in our neighborhood.
Academy classes start in the evening.
My friend works as an instructor at an English academy.

explain: 한국에서는 학원 이름에 '아카데미'를 붙이는 곳이 있어요. 영화의 '아카데미상'에도 같은 말이 들어가요. 일반적인 학원을 부를 때는 '학원'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I go to an art academy every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 배우는 분야 이름을 앞에 붙여 학원 이름처럼 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the subject in front to make it sound like the name of a school.

phrases.en: That movie won an Academy Award.
phrases.nuance_ko: 영화에서 가장 유명한 상 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The name of the most famous award in film.

phrases.en: My younger sibling attends a cooking academy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학원에 다닌다고 말할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing for saying you attend a school like this.

explain_en: Some private institutes in Korea put 아카데미 in their names. The same word is part of the film award 아카데미상. For a typical cram school or institute, the usual word is 학원.

examples.ko: 영화사에서 새 영화의 배우를 찾고 있어요.
examples.en: The film company is looking for actors for its new movie.
After graduating from university, I got a job at a film company.

examples.ko: 그 영화사는 작은 영화를 많이 만들어요.
examples.en: That film company makes many small movies.
The film company will release the trailer next month.

examples.ko: 영화사 직원이 감독님과 회의를 하고 있어요.
examples.en: A film company employee is having a meeting with the director.

examples.ko: 큰 영화사와 계약한 감독이 새 영화를 준비해요.
examples.en: The director who signed with a big film company is preparing a new movie.

explain: '출판사', '방송사', '여행사'처럼 '-사'로 끝나는 회사 이름 중 하나예요. 영화를 직접 만드는 회사도, 극장에 영화를 공급하는 회사도 영화사라고 불러요.

phrases.en: That person is an employee of a film company.
phrases.nuance_ko: 회사에서 일하는 사람을 말할 때 '직원'을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '직원' to talk about someone who works at the company.

phrases.en: The head of the film company met the director.
phrases.nuance_ko: 회사의 가장 높은 사람을 말할 때 '대표'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '대표' to refer to the head of the company.

phrases.en: My older sister works at a film company.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일하는 곳을 말할 때 '-에서 일하다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '-에서 일하다' to say where someone works.
phrases.en_equiv: to work at a film company

explain_en: It is one of the company names ending in -사, like 출판사, 방송사, and 여행사. Both studios that make films and firms that supply films to theaters are called 영화사.

examples.ko: 오늘 선생님이 안 계셔서 자습을 했어요.
examples.en: The teacher wasn't here today, so we had self-study.

examples.ko: 야간 자습이 끝나고 집에 가면 열 시예요.
examples.en: When I get home after evening self-study, it's ten o'clock.
You have to be quiet during self-study time.
Studying alone is hard, so I go to a cram school.

examples.ko: 수업이 갑자기 자습으로 바뀌어서 다들 좋아했어요.
examples.en: The class suddenly turned into self-study, and everyone was happy.
During vacation I study by myself at the library.

explain: 학교에서 선생님이 가르치지 않고 학생이 스스로 공부하는 시간을 '자습 시간'이라고 해요. '자습을 시키다'는 선생님 입장, '자습하다'는 학생 입장에서 써요. 선생님 없이 혼자 배우는 것은 '독학'이라고도 해요.

phrases.en: I study on my own in the library.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동사로 바꿔서 학생 입장에서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form, used from the student's point of view.

phrases.en: You have to be quiet during self-study time.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교에서 스스로 공부하는 시간을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The time at school set aside for self-study.

phrases.en: I do evening self-study.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밤에 학교에서 하는 자습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Self-study done at school at night.

explain_en: At school, a period where students study on their own without a teacher teaching is called '자습 시간'. '자습을 시키다' is from the teacher's side and '자습하다' from the student's. Learning alone without a teacher can also be called '독학'.

t90.ax: You have to be quiet during self-study time.

en: to work on (a task, project, or creative piece)

examples.en: I work at home at night.
I went to bed late working on a video yesterday.
I'm in the middle of working on the design.
The friend I worked with helped me.

examples.ko: 조용한 카페에서 작업하면 집중이 잘 돼요.
examples.en: I focus well when working in a quiet cafe.
I'll work on this drawing until tomorrow.

explain: 공부나 사무가 아니라 그림, 영상, 음악, 사진처럼 만드는 결과물이 있는 일에 잘 써요. 회사 일 전반은 '일하다'가 자연스러워요. '작업'은 '작업 중'처럼 명사로도 많이 써요.

phrases.en: I worked on music all night yesterday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 결과물을 만드는 일에 오랫동안 매달렸을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when spending a long time on a creative project.

phrases.en: I work on a picture together with my friend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여럿이 함께 결과물을 만들 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when several people make something together.

phrases.en: I'm working on a video right now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 하고 있는 중이라고 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Commonly used to say you are in the middle of working.

explain_en: It fits work that yields something you make, like pictures, videos, music or photos, not studying or office tasks. For jobs in general, the plain verb for 'work' sounds more natural. The noun form is also used often, as in 'in progress'.

dis.h: work on a task, project or craft
gh: work at a set workplace during duty hours
formal: hold a post at an organization
everyday general word for working or doing a job

p.n: 작업하다 means working on a specific piece of work. 일하다 is more general and often means having a job.

examples.en: A debate will be held at school tomorrow.
The debate lasted for two hours.
I am preparing for the debate with a friend.
The teacher also took part in this debate.
Many opinions came up at the debate.

examples.ko: 집에서도 토론회 방송을 볼 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can watch the debate broadcast from home as well.

explain: '토론'은 말로 의견을 주고받는 일이고, '토론회'는 그런 자리를 여는 행사예요. 선거 때 뉴스에서 '후보 토론회'라는 말이 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: I took part in the school debate.
phrases.nuance_ko: 행사에 직접 나갈 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The usual phrase for joining the event in person.
phrases.en_equiv: to take part in a debate

phrases.en: I watched the candidates' debate on TV.
phrases.nuance_ko: 선거 때 뉴스에서 자주 나오는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often heard in election-time news.

phrases.en: I discussed environmental problems with my friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 행사가 아니라 의견을 주고받는 일 자체를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the act of exchanging opinions, not the event.

explain_en: '토론' is the exchange of opinions in speech, and '토론회' is the event held for it. In election news you often hear '후보 토론회' (candidate debate).

examples.en: The teacher handed out printouts.
One printout is missing.
This handout will be on tomorrow's test.
Write your name on the printout and hand it in.
I find it easier to study with printouts.
I put the class handouts in my bag too.

explain: 종이에 인쇄한 수업 자료를 가리킬 때 써요. 옷에 그려진 무늬도 '프린트 티셔츠'처럼 같은 말을 써요. 인쇄하는 일은 '인쇄'나 '프린트하다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: I got a handout in class.
phrases.nuance_ko: 선생님이나 다른 사람에게서 자료를 받을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when you receive a paper from a teacher or someone else.

phrases.en: I bought a printed T-shirt with a picture on it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옷에 그려진 무늬를 말할 때도 같은 말을 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The same word is used for patterns printed on clothes.

phrases.en: I printed my homework and handed it in.
phrases.nuance_ko: 종이에 인쇄하는 일을 할 때 쓰는 동사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form for the act of printing something on paper.

explain_en: It refers to course material printed on paper. A pattern on clothes uses the same word, as in 프린트 티셔츠. The act of printing is 인쇄 or 프린트하다.

examples.ko: 이 문서는 하루에 백 장씩 프린트돼요.
examples.en: This document is printed a hundred copies a day.
The test papers have already been printed.
The ticket will be printed soon.
Please wait a moment while it is printing.
After the photo was printed, I put it in a frame.
The letters are printed small, so they are hard to read.

explain: '프린트하다'는 사람이 인쇄하는 쪽이고 '프린트되다'는 종이에 인쇄되어 나오는 쪽을 봐요. '프린트가 나오다'라고 말하기도 해요.

phrases.en: The printout comes out of the printer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 종이가 기계에서 나오는 모습을 말할 때 쓰는 비슷한 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A similar expression that describes the paper coming out of the machine.

phrases.en: The text doesn't print well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 인쇄가 제대로 안 될 때 '-지 않다'를 붙여 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '-지 않다' to say something isn't printing properly.

phrases.en: This book is printed in Korea.
phrases.nuance_ko: '프린트되다'와 같은 뜻의 한자어예요. 책이나 신문에 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: A Sino-Korean word with the same meaning, more natural for books and newspapers.

explain_en: 프린트하다 looks at the person who prints, while 프린트되다 looks at what comes out printed on the paper. People also say 프린트가 나오다.

t90.ax: The ticket will be printed soon.

examples.en: The kids are playing with a ball on the playground.
We broke a window while playing with a ball.
Ball games are more fun the more people there are.
Do you want to go to the park to play ball?

examples.ko: 어릴 때는 매일 골목에서 공놀이로 하루를 보냈어요.
examples.en: As a kid, I spent every day playing ball in the alley.

examples.ko: 공놀이에 푹 빠져서 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
examples.en: I was so absorbed in the ball game that I lost track of time.

explain: 축구나 야구처럼 규칙이 있는 경기보다 공을 가지고 가볍게 노는 느낌이에요. 보통 '공놀이를 하다'로 써요.

phrases.en: I play with a ball in the park on weekends.
phrases.nuance_ko: '공놀이를 하다'를 붙여 쓴 동사 형태예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A verb form that attaches 공놀이를 하다 together.

phrases.en: My dog loves playing with a ball.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람과 동물 모두에게 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Can be used for both people and animals.

phrases.en: I'm going to play ball with my friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 목적을 말할 때 '-러 가다'와 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with -러 가다 to state a purpose.

explain_en: It feels like casual play with a ball, rather than a rule-based sport such as soccer or baseball. It usually appears as '공놀이를 하다'.

examples.en: We held an impromptu singing contest at the party.
I took part in our village's singing contest.
The first prize at the singing contest is a refrigerator.
Grandmother won a prize at the singing contest.
We decided to have a singing contest at the company dinner.
A singing contest is being broadcast this evening.

explain: 동네 잔치나 모임, 방송에서 여러 사람이 차례로 나와 노래를 부르는 대회예요. '노래자랑에 나가다', '노래자랑을 열다'처럼 말해요. 전문 가수를 뽑는 오디션보다 가볍고 즐거운 분위기예요.

phrases.en: My older brother entered the school singing contest.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대회에 직접 출전한다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to say you take part in the contest.

phrases.en: A singing contest is held in the neighborhood.
phrases.nuance_ko: '대회'를 붙이면 행사라는 느낌이 더 분명해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 대회 makes it clearer that it is an event.

phrases.en: I was very nervous on the singing contest stage.
phrases.nuance_ko: 노래하는 무대를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to talk about the stage where people sing.

explain_en: It is an event, at a village festival, gathering or on TV, where people take turns singing. You say '노래자랑에 나가다' or '노래자랑을 열다'. It has a lighter, more fun mood than an audition to choose professional singers.

t90.ax: I took part in our village's singing contest.

examples.en: Our class is preparing for the relay.

examples.ko: 릴레이는 바통을 정확히 넘기는 게 중요해요.
examples.en: In a relay, passing the baton correctly is important.

examples.ko: 릴레이 경기에서 마지막 주자가 일등을 했어요.
examples.en: In the relay race, the last runner came first.
I dropped the baton in the relay but ran to the end.

examples.ko: 친구들이 릴레이로 편지를 써서 선생님께 드렸어요.
examples.en: My friends wrote a letter in turns and gave it to the teacher.

examples.ko: 우리 동아리는 릴레이 소설을 쓰기로 했어요.
examples.en: Our club decided to write a relay novel.

explain: 운동 경기에서는 '이어달리기'라고도 해요. 'SNS 릴레이', '릴레이 소설'처럼 여러 사람이 차례로 이어 가는 일 앞에 붙여요.

phrases.en: We had a relay race at the sports day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바통을 넘기며 달리는 경기를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a race where runners pass a baton.

phrases.en: Our team came first in the relay race.
phrases.nuance_ko: 운동 경기의 '릴레이'와 같은 뜻의 순우리말 계열 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A native Korean word with the same meaning as relay in sports.

phrases.en: I wrote a relay story with my friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 사람이 차례로 이어서 쓰는 이야기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A story written by several people in turn.

explain_en: In sports it is also called '이어달리기'. It is put in front of things many people continue in turn, like 'SNS 릴레이' and '릴레이 소설'.

en: to screen; to show (a film or program)

examples.en: The theater is showing a new movie.
The school screened a documentary.

examples.ko: 그 영화는 오늘 몇 시에 상영하나요?
examples.en: What time does that movie show today?

examples.ko: 영화를 상영하는 동안 휴대폰을 꺼 주세요.
examples.en: Please turn off your phone while the film is playing.

examples.ko: 공원에서 매주 금요일에 영화를 상영해 줘요.
examples.en: They show a movie in the park every Friday.
They will start showing that movie tomorrow.

explain: 극장이나 행사에서 영화를 틀어 줄 때 써요. 집에서 영화를 볼 때는 '상영' 대신 '틀다'나 '보다'를 써요. 연극이나 콘서트는 '공연하다'예요.

phrases.en: The theater is showing a Korean movie.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 영화를 틀어 주는 중일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when a place is showing a film right now.

phrases.example: 다음 달에 새 영화를 상영할 예정이에요.
phrases.en: They plan to show a new movie next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 틀어 줄 계획을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to talk about a screening planned for the future.

phrases.example: 이 극장은 외국 영화를 상영하지 않아요.
phrases.en: This theater doesn't show foreign movies.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 영화를 틀어 주지 않는다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to say a place doesn't show a certain film.

explain_en: It is used when a theater or event plays a film. At home you would say 틀다 or 보다 rather than 상영하다. For plays and concerts, use 공연하다.

dis.h: show a film at a theater
gh: play for fun; hang out with friends
play piano, guitar or racket sports; hit

p.n: 상영하다 is only for showing films or programs, so 놀다 does not fit.
